name: 【UPDATE】The Wild Robot：Roz’s Animal Find Adventure
desc:
🎉Thank you for playing! This experience will be closing on **Tuesday, September 30th**. Please enjoy it to the fullest until then!

🌟Welcome to the Official ROBLOX Experience of the movie “The Wild Robot”!🌟

Dive into the world of Roz, the wild robot, and explore a mysterious island filled with nature and adventure!

🐾Find and collect 30 unique animals across 6 breathtaking biomes, including mountains, snowfields, and oceans.

📖Learn about the animals by recording your discoveries in an interactive animal encyclopedia!
💡Unlock 3 special skills by discovering rare animals and access even more places to explore!

🎥Based on the Movie The Wild Robot, hitting theaters February 7, 2025!
